Built **Pokéventure**, a playable Pokémon-inspired incremental trainer game in `index.html`.

Choose a starter, explore for wild creatures, catch or battle them, grow your party, earn idle coins, buy upgrades, complete a catch challenge, and unlock new regions. Progress saves locally and earns capped offline coins. The layout adapts to mobile.

I checked the game in-browser and verified the starter selection and encounter flow. I assumed an original, lightweight browser game with no external assets or dependencies.
